title: The Problem: All Entries Load at Once

blocks.content: Course: React Hooks: Level Up Your First Web App
The Problem: All Entries Load at Once
The API currently returns twenty entries and they all render at once:

1// Run the code
2// You'll see that 20 entries render all at once
1/* Daily Journal App — React Hooks edition css goes here */
A real journal could have hundreds. Loading and rendering the full list is not only wasteful, but also overwhelming for the user.
Pagination solves this by showing a fixed number of entries per page. The user navigates with Previous and Next buttons.
The page slice is derived state: it is always computable from filteredEntries and currentPage. So they both go into useMemo().
Now, let's start by adding the page state and computing the slice.
